claim_scope: Exact Laurent-polynomial factorization of det(DQ(b)-bI) for the defined six-mode matrices, together with the zero-momentum characteristic polynomial and eigenvalue multiplicities.
load_bearing_step: Multiplying the three block determinants by the rank-one multiplier (b+1)/(b-1) gives the stated determinant factorization.
notes_for_re_audit_if_any: A second auditor should recheck the block-inverse contribution and the Laurent-polynomial extension across exceptional parameter values.
title: Six-Mode Paired-Direction Coin `b`-Eigenvalue Determinant Factorization
verdict_rationale: Independent hand expansion gives det(B_t)=-b(b-1)(t-1)^2/(2t) and 1^T B_t^-1(t,t^-1)^T=2/(b-1), so their product yields the stated Laurent factorization. At D=I, the scalar line, even orthogonal subspace, and odd subspace give eigenvalues 1, -1, and b with multiplicities 1, 2, and 3. The argument uses only the explicitly defined matrices and exact algebra, with no imported physical identification or unresolved dependency.
